sources.summary: Domhnall Gleeson and scene-stealing Sabrina Impacciatore lead the shenanigans in the newsroom mockumentary. Plus: Ludwig returns. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Sky One The mockumentary about a local newspaper from the writers of The Office US is back – which, crucially, means the return of show-stealing Sabrina Impacciatore as clueless managing editor Esmeralda. New editor Ned (Domhnall Gleeson) may now have an award-winning team, but it has only made them hungry for more wild stories. sources.summary: The Bill & Ted actor answers your questions about working with Keanu Reeves, whether there will be a fourth instalment and nights out in Brixton with the Death Wish director You were born in London but grew up in America . When do you feel most British? DonarudoToranpu The UK is still my second home. I’ve worked there a lot as an adult. When I’m back in London, I like walking on Hampstead Heath, so I would say that’s where I feel most at home. Having played Marko in The Lost Boys and then John Polidori in Haunted Summer , have you been tempted to take on another vampire-related role? And was getting staked to death while you were sleeping a bit of a disappointing end for Marko – what would have been your preferred way of going out in style? Death by stereo, perhaps? Finbarre and MoreorLesPaul I’d love to do another vampire movie. I love those characters. They’re interesting and great fun to play. There are some really good vampire movies – I’m grateful I was in one that has, for some reason that none of us can figure out, really stood the test of time. And I love Marko’s death. As an actor, the first time you get staked is the most memorable. Continue reading...

thread_text:
影劇圈今晚看點

先看今晚電視。美劇《The Paper》回歸，這部由《The Office》原班編劇打造的偽紀錄片，繼續描寫地方報社的荒唐日常，由多諾·葛里森（Domhnall Gleeson）與莎賓娜·伊帕齊亞托雷（Sabrina Impacciatore）主演。

再看專訪。《Bill & Ted》系列演員亞歷克斯·溫特（Alex Winter），聊到與基努·李維（Keanu Reeves）合作的往事，也形容已故導演麥可·溫納（Michael Winner）是他遇過「最博學的反社會人格者」。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
影劇圈今晚看點

先看今晚電視。美劇《The Paper》回歸，這部由《The Office》美版原班編劇打造的偽紀錄片，繼續描寫地方報社的荒唐日常。新任總編輯（多諾·葛里森飾）雖然帶著一支剛拿過獎的團隊，卻反而更飢渴地想挖更多爆炸性新聞，加上一段辦公室戀情帶來的人資風波，讓故事更添火花。

再看專訪。《Bill & Ted》系列演員亞歷克斯·溫特（Alex Winter），接受讀者提問，聊到與基努·李維（Keanu Reeves）合作的往事，也回憶自己在《失落的男孩》裡演吸血鬼馬可、被木樁刺死的橋段。他形容已故導演麥可·溫納（Michael Winner）是他遇過「最博學的反社會人格者」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 先看今晚的電視。有一部美劇回歸，由《辦公室》美版的原班編劇打造，用偽紀錄片的方式，繼續描寫地方報社的荒唐日常。新任總編輯雖然帶著一支剛拿過獎的團隊，卻反而更想挖更多爆炸性新聞，還多了一段辦公室戀情添亂。換個話題，看一段演員專訪。一位曾演出《Bill & Ted》系列的演員，聊到跟基努·李維合作的往事，也形容已故導演麥可·溫納，是他遇過「最博學的反社會人格者」。
